    right="Feat 17"

>
[Boneyard Acquaintance](/Feats.aspx?ID=5266) <actions string="" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="All Ancestries" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=467" />
<trait label="Reincarnated" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=783" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 81

</column>

---

Before your soul returned to the Material Plane, you interacted with a host of other souls on their way to the Boneyard. One of these acquaintances owes you a favor. You can temporarily summon it to come to your aid, and it appears as a swirling mass of ectoplasm with indiscernible features and a translucent dagger, the favored weapon of Pharasma. This functions as [_spiritual guardian_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1688), which you can cast once per day as a divine innate spell, but you don't need to worship a deity to do so.
